rows.item: Page scan reader: second passes that only add readings (entry-grade, as the QC Master's scan entry)
rows.change: James: "the OCR of artifact need to improve", "the read is adding order into the system. it is an entry". Three second passes, each used only when the first pass failed, so none can lose a reading: (1) a row whose printed bars a pen stroke hid takes the column positions of the page's other rows and is read by both readers (SE31 RP26413-1); (2) a page whose line is not certain from its header and glyph reads takes the line its orders on file ran on, two or more, all one line (SE12, page 2); (3) an order suffix read with more characters than the image shows is read again at the other settings before it is trimmed (H6AA271-31 and RP26327-41- for -1). Measured blind (each day's own orders hidden) on the five copier scans on file (28, 29, 30 Sep, 29 Oct and its revision, 338 rows): entered right 331 -> 337, wrong 0 -> 0, left for a person 7 -> 1 (H6AA010-1: a stray mark reads as a letter in the number at every setting). Reference reader (ui/ocr_eval.py audit3) changed first; parity kept

rows.item: Help loop: the page asks Claude about the rows it could not read
rows.change: James: "yes build it" (the QC Master's help loop). Each scan the page reads is recorded in the artifact's database (date, file, rows, boxed). A button "Ask Claude to read N rows" sends the boxed and unread rows (what the readers saw, the closest pair on file and the row's picture, about 11 KB) for Claude to read by eye; Claude's answer fills in on the page, the person checks it against the picture and presses Apply, which records whether Claude was right or corrected. A line under the drop box shows the last 7 days: scans, rows, read by the page, boxed, sent to Claude, confirmed, corrected. Only Contributors and above can read or write it (a public-link viewer sees nothing). Claude's side: ui/help_rows.py and CLAUDE.md "The help loop". Tested locally end to end (29 Oct scan read blind: H6AA010-1 boxed, answered, confirmed, Word unlocked) and live (scan record written)
